entries.reason: MLMultiArrayDataTypeFloat16 = 0x10000 | 16: the element type a multi-array of that type holds. A case is a value the consumer inlines at compile time, so the port carries it by carrying the header and there is nothing of its own to define
entries.effect: the consumer writes MLMultiArrayDataTypeFloat16 and the SDK's own value (0x10000 | 16) is what its code carries; no release's Core ML carries a different one
entries.source: SDK 16.4, MLMultiArray.h:18-23, the enumerator as the SDK writes it: the value is Apple's own, inlined into the consumer's code at compile time, and no release's Core ML carries a different one
